findings.title: Presenting complaint, 5 Nov 2026
findings.detail: Left leg and left hip pain after a slip and fall from the stairs at home at about 11 am on 5 Nov 2026, with reduced movement of the left lower limb. No loss of consciousness, headache, ENT bleed or vomiting.
findings.verbatim: c/o Left leg pain & left hip pain. H/o slip and fall from steps

findings.title: Low oxygen saturation on arrival, oxygen started
findings.detail: SpO2 90% at FiO2 21% on the ED trauma record. Oxygen 4 L by nasal prongs was started at 2:20 PM, and two cycles of Duolin and Budecort nebulisation and hydrocortisone 100 mg IV were given. A further note beside 'Air entry: B/L equal' is partly read and may refer to both lungs.

findings.verbatim: RR: 20/min SpO2: 90% @fiO2: 21%. Air entry: B/L Equal / [..] (+)

findings.title: Orthopaedic examination, 5 Nov 2026
findings.detail: Left lower limb shortened and externally rotated, tenderness over the left hip; movement of the left hip and knee could not be assessed due to pain. No external injuries, no swelling. Right hip, knee and both ankles move within normal limits; active toe movements present on both sides; distal pulses palpable, distal sensation intact. Nil significant injuries of the upper limbs, spine, pelvis, abdomen, chest, face and skull.
findings.verbatim: Left lower limb shortened and externally rotated - No external injuries - No swelling - Tenderness present over left hip - ROM left hip and knee couldn't be assessed due to pain

findings.title: History after the injury
findings.detail: No loss of consciousness and no bleeding from ENT. Had not passed urine after the injury. No preliminary treatment given elsewhere; came by self-referral. Immunisation status not known.

findings.detail: Cough and generalised weakness for 3 days. The ED record adds mucoid expectoration, shortness of breath (mMRC grade 2) and low grade fever without chills for 3 days; no sweating, chest pain, vomiting, abdominal pain, orthopnoea or PND.

findings.title: History in the Medicine note, 15 May 2026
findings.detail: Cough for 3 days, nonproductive, no blood, wheeze present, no SOB or PND. One episode of fever, no chills, no night sweats. General fatigue and reduced appetite. No focal deficit or altered sensorium, no bowel or bladder complaints, no travel history, no similar illness. Known T2DM and HTN; no history of RAD or IHD.
